OkuFlow Camera is provided by Cem Kaya. Updated 12 October 2026. This policy covers the Android companion and explains its connection to OkuFlow for Windows.

With camera permission, the app encodes live camera video and sends it by an authorized USB debugging connection to your computer. It also sends camera capabilities, codec and capture settings, frame timing, and error information. The phone app has no Internet permission and does not request microphone, location or contacts access.

On the phone, video is held in memory for streaming rather than saved as recordings. Camera and setup preferences are stored locally; the light resets off for a new connection. Restore automatic settings resets camera preferences. Android app storage controls or uninstalling remove stored preferences. Backup and device transfer of app data are disabled.

OkuFlow for Windows can save photos, recordings, notes and diagnostic logs on your computer. If you use its optional AI features, images and questions can be sent to your selected Codex or vision service. That service has its own privacy and retention terms. Delete saved computer files through Windows; clearing this phone app does not delete them or provider-held data.

Authorize USB debugging only on a computer you trust. An authorized debugging connection gives the computer broad access to the phone. Disconnect the cable when finished; you can turn off USB debugging or revoke debugging authorizations in Developer options. USB authorization is not a claim of encrypted video transfer.

Privacy questions: contact Cem Kaya through the public OkuFlow repository issues. Issues are public; do not post camera images, credentials or private documents. Opening the public policy or contact link uses your browser and its connection to GitHub.
You can show the camera service notice in the notification drawer. This is optional; declining does not stop streaming.

The camera is stopped. Choose Resume streaming when ready. Reconnecting or reopening the app keeps it paused.
The camera is paused, but this choice could not be saved. Keep the cable disconnected before reopening the app. Try Resume streaming again after checking app storage.
